title: At Meta Connect, the company's smart glasses were everywhere | TechCrunch
summary: One of the more notable products I had an opportunity to demo were Meta’s new, still-unreleased, audio-only smart glasses . The glasses will also integrate with Muse, Meta’s personal agentic system, which can carry out tasks on the user’s behalf.
